approvalContract.rule: A recommendation is not an approval. Missing fields keep the decision REQUIRES_EXPERT_REVIEW.

decisions.title: Store-credit tender disposition
decisions.recommendation: Hide and reject STORE_CREDIT in the current POS. Introduce it later only through a separately governed customer-liability ledger and redemption workflow.

decisions.title: Physical session and drawer boundary
decisions.recommendation: Use an explicit physical terminal/register claim with at most one active terminal session and one active drawer claim. Cashier identity is an actor, not the lock key.

decisions.title: First electronic payment provider
decisions.recommendation: Choose one named country/provider/merchant sandbox with signed callbacks, documented status and reversal semantics, statement source, secret custody and a kill switch. Keep electronic tender disabled until selected.

decisions.title: Offline tender policy
decisions.recommendation: Start with bounded cash-only offline operation after device, sequence, replay and conflict gates. Do not accept offline electronic payments without provider certification.

decisions.title: Browser, terminal and peripheral support matrix
decisions.recommendation: Approve a narrow named matrix for browser/OS, terminal identity, printer, scanner, cash drawer and reference network; fail closed outside it for pilot claims.

decisions.title: Returns, voids and refunds policy
decisions.recommendation: Use linked partial-capable compensating workflows with reason codes, return disposition, provider/fiscal consequences, fresh authentication and maker-checker thresholds. Never rewrite completed facts.

decisions.title: Pilot country, currency, language and fiscal profile
decisions.recommendation: Use Cameroon/XAF/EN-FR only as a development pilot until a qualified reviewer approves minor-unit, rounding, tax, receipt, numbering, correction and retention rules against dated sources.

decisions.title: Pilot service levels and error budgets
decisions.recommendation: Adopt the roadmap performance budgets only after the D-05 reference matrix is approved, then establish provider, receipt, replay, reconciliation and close SLOs from measured baselines.

decisions.title: Delivery invoice recognition event
decisions.recommendation: Default invoice eligibility to accepted physical delivery/hand-over quantity. Any advance-billing policy must be explicit, versioned and approved; order confirmation remains non-posting.

decisions.title: Reservation, availability and goods-issue policy
decisions.recommendation: Reservation changes reserved and available quantities only. Physical hand-over/dispatch owns goods issue, on-hand reduction and COGS. Negative stock and unsupported lot/serial/UOM combinations fail closed.

decisions.title: Business-day, statement and accounting-close boundary
decisions.recommendation: Model cashier session, drawer declaration, governed business day, provider statement, reconciliation run and accounting close as separate versioned objects with distinct owners and observable states.
